Founder 2026-09-29: Bucket reports and atlases ship as Research OS pages on bucket.foundation, generated by a repo pipeline (software that builds software). Never publish them as Claude artifacts.

Founder 2026-09-30: evolve existing components, never rewrite in place. Copy the existing search component (and any component being upgraded) to a new versioned file, keep the original untouched as the backup, and build the upgrade on the copy.
Founder copy (2026-09-28): 'Research OS is an exploration and mastery tool.' Use it in site and product copy.
Founder core principle: open data. Don't lock knowledge up; teaching and data carry open licenses; people keep full ownership of what they generate. Apply to every Bucket and Research OS design.

Founder direction 2026-10-01 (Bucket Foundation): (1) DePIN is a highly integral direction: the desktop app is the node. (2) Stablecoin: payments settle in stablecoin, consistent with the x402 on Base rail. (3) Everything must be functional on desktop, Linux first. (4) The data engine (explore, search, canon, graphs) is 'our data interaction location' and must be Rust, since it must be Rust at scale. (5) Lean belongs in the architecture. (6) Founder cares most about Explore and the measured impact of the tool on users' tasks. Architecture epic: see bead titled 'Bucket target architecture'.
Founder motivation: scientific discovery. Key explanatory variable of discovery = human capability and human-AI (HAI) capability. Frame idea work around raising discovery rate via capability.

Founder rule 2026-09-28: every piece of work we do must be doable inside Research OS. Each tool (prime directions, profile builder, advisor review, network map, visual engine with Manim and Blender, Cadence audio, statements, Lean checks) gets a Research OS surface or MCP tool.

Founder rule: never overwrite generated visuals. Every render run writes to a new dated version folder; archive at ~/.local/share/bucket-profiles/versions/ mirrored to gdrive:AGFarms/Nucleus/bucket-foundation/visual-versions/.
Founder rule: point to information and open it (xdg-open files, figures, PDFs, URLs) instead of retelling contents in replies. Added to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md Output Tokens.
Founder rule refinement: answers go in the reply; never generate a file just to hold an answer and point to it. Point only to sources that exist for their own sake.
Founder style rule: never write 'I'm a ...' / 'I build ...' self-description headlines about the founder. Lead with the work or the question itself.

Founder wants to be kept in the loop by surprise quizzes: in bkt-nuc sessions, now and then end a reply with one timed quiz question about work done (numbers, decisions, sources). Rare and random, answer checked next turn.

Open data + ownership of generation is three things at once: the founder's personal principle, a Bucket Foundation principle, and the rule of the data marketplace (bkt-f31u): people own what they generate and choose to share, sell or license it openly.

Scientific lab notebook: every result gets a JSONL entry (kind theorem/measured/estimate/design, value, uncertainty, method, source + sha256, verification, status) in ~/agfarms/provenance/lab-notebook/<date>.jsonl, signed and timestamped, mirrored to Drive founder-review/lab-notebook. The daily critic job appends to it.
